/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):
  super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.refs=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if a.get('href','').startswith('#'): self.refs.append(a['href'][1:])
c=Check(); c.feed(s)
assert len(c.ids)==len(set(c.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
assert not set(c.refs)-set(c.ids), set(c.refs)-set(c.ids)
assert len(list(Path('.').iterdir()))==1
start=s.index('<script>')+len('<script>'); end=s.index('</script>',start)
Path('/private/tmp/kestrel-script.js').write_text(s[start:end])
print(f'HTML parsed; {len(c.ids)} unique IDs; all fragment references resolved; one output file; {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes.')
PY"

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('index.html')

for value in ['6.4','3.1','3.2']:
 s=s.replace(f'</svg>{value}%<span class=\"sr-only\"> increase', f'</svg>+{value}%<span class=\"sr-only\"> increase')
s=s.replace('</svg>0.3 pp<span class=\"sr-only\"> decrease','</svg>−0.3 pp<span class=\"sr-only\"> decrease')
s=s.replace('.mobile-menu{display:none;background:none;padding:5px}', '.mobile-search-toggle{display:none;background:none;padding:6px;color:#9aa19b}.mobile-menu{display:none;background:none;padding:5px}')
s=s.replace('.search-box input,.search-box kbd{display:none}', '.search-box input,.search-box kbd{display:none}.search-box{display:none}.mobile-search-toggle{display:block}.mobile-search .mobile-search-toggle{display:none}.mobile-search .search-box{display:flex}')
s=s.replace('<div class=\"search-wrap\" id=\"search-wrap\"><label', '<div class=\"search-wrap\" id=\"search-wrap\"><button class=\"mobile-search-toggle\" id=\"open-search\" aria-label=\"Search orders, products, customers\"><svg class=\"icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\"><use href=\"#i-search\"/></svg></button><label')
s=s.replace(\""'$('"'#search-icon').parentElement.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(matchMedia('(max-width:760px)').matches){"'$('"'#search-wrap').classList.add('mobile-search');searchInput.focus();}});\", \""'$('"'#open-search').addEventListener('click',()=>{"'$('"'#search-wrap').classList.add('mobile-search');searchInput.focus();});\")
p.write_text(s)
start=s.index('<script>')+len('<script>');end=s.index('</script>',start)
Path('/private/tmp/kestrel-script.js').write_text(s[start:end])
